brief:
Election results have exposed growing divisions within Israel's ultra-Orthodox Haredi society, according to Middle East Eye. The divisions raise questions about the future of the Haredi political alliance with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, which has been a defining feature of Israeli politics for decades.

The results suggest the bloc that has traditionally voted as a cohesive political force is fracturing, with different Haredi factions pursuing divergent interests and strategies.

title: Israeli election results expose deepening divisions in ultra-Orthodox community
